messages.declared-member-over-cap: a member is over the per-member decompression cap — refusing a possible zip bomb
messages.declared-total-over-cap: bundle is over the aggregate decompression cap — refusing a possible zip bomb
messages.directory-misplaced: container is not in canonical form — the central directory does not end where the end-of-central-directory record begins
messages.directory-record-overrun: container is not in canonical form — a central-directory record runs past the directory
messages.directory-record-signature: container is not in canonical form — a central-directory record is missing its signature
messages.directory-trailing-bytes: container is not in canonical form — the central directory holds bytes after its last record
messages.duplicate-name: bundle central directory repeats member name(s) — refusing to import: duplicated members shadow each other
messages.entry-counters-disagree: container is not in canonical form — the two entry counters disagree
messages.eocd-comment-length: container is not in canonical form — the end-of-central-directory record declares a comment
messages.eocd-not-last: container is not in canonical form — the end-of-central-directory record is not the last 22 bytes of the file
messages.local-header-out-of-range: container is not in canonical form — a member's local header lies outside the member area
messages.local-header-signature: container is not in canonical form — a member's local header is missing its signature
messages.local-name-mismatch: container is not in canonical form — a member's local header names a different file than the directory does
messages.member-crc-mismatch: a member failed its CRC-32 check
messages.member-data-out-of-range: container is not in canonical form — a member's data runs into the central directory
messages.member-inflate-error: a member is not a valid deflate stream
messages.member-over-cap: a member inflated past the per-member cap — refusing a possible zip bomb
messages.member-size-mismatch: a member inflated to a different size than its directory record declares
messages.multi-disk: container is not in canonical form — multi-disk archive fields are set
messages.record-comment: container is not in canonical form — a central-directory record declares a comment
messages.record-encrypted: container is not in canonical form — a member is encrypted
messages.record-method: container is not in canonical form — a member uses a compression method other than stored or deflate
messages.record-multi-disk: container is not in canonical form — a member is declared on another disk
messages.record-name-empty: container is not in canonical form — a member has an empty name
messages.record-name-encoding: container is not in canonical form — a member name is not valid UTF-8, or is non-ASCII without the UTF-8 flag
messages.record-stored-size: container is not in canonical form — a stored member declares two different sizes
messages.record-zip64: container is not in canonical form — a member carries ZIP64 sentinel values
messages.too-many-entries: bundle declares over {max_entries} entries — refusing a possible zip bomb
messages.too-short: not a readable zip archive — shorter than an end-of-central-directory record
messages.total-over-cap: bundle inflated past the aggregate cap — refusing a possible zip bomb
messages.zip64: container is not in canonical form — ZIP64 structures are present
